semantic_findings.subject: Private report helper
semantic_findings.finding: The only visibility delta removes pub(super) from a use inside its existing parent. The child helper is not widened; the local imported call remains. No production API is opened.

semantic_findings.subject: Peer identity metadata
semantic_findings.finding: The existing peer has three public identity fields. The patch copies only these previously held values at three test callsites. The original pidfd creation, process lifetime, boot/start identity, socket peer credentials and UID predicates remain byte-for-byte unchanged. No Clone implementation, capability duplication, procfs rediscovery or guard relaxation is added.

semantic_findings.subject: Source to Cell input
semantic_findings.finding: The two formerly ill-typed comparisons are replaced by the exact original private Source::input projection: eight source fields plus the already authenticated opaque publication's operation ID. Full CellStepInput equality is preserved. This comparison does not independently establish operation ID correctness or lease_duration_ms; those continue to depend on the untouched original owners and source admission.

semantic_findings.subject: Actual witness postimage
semantic_findings.finding: The real fix output changes nonzero remainder to negated is_multiple_of. Whole-file inverse equality shows no other delta. The original pre-subtraction length guard remains. This postimage is protected, not reapplied or reset.

byte_and_merkle_review.inventory_provenance: Lossless reconstruction equal to original producer-observed bytes/SHA/Git; not a second native inventory read.
